briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.4%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on signal. With 3 open slots and $589 in cash, we're holding rather than forcing a buy — past experience shows deploying capital just to fill slots on neutral days doesn't pay off, and no candidate today shows the full multi-signal confirmation (RSI, MACD, price/SMA, and volume surge) we look for.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors hold back from new positions because market signals aren't strongly positive, even if there's cash available to deploy. It's not about the market crashing — it's about discipline: waiting for genuine confirmation (multiple bullish signals together) rather than buying just because you can.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）指投資者在市場訊號不夠強烈時，選擇不開新倉，即使手頭有現金可用。這不代表市場暴跌，而是一種紀律：寧願等待真正明確的買入訊號（多項利好指標同時出現），也不會單純因為「有錢可用」而貿然入市。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, low-conviction trading, with NASDAQ down 0.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move — it reflects a market pausing rather than reacting to major news. Volume and volatility both stayed muted, consistent with a wait-and-see mood among investors.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市偏軟，納斯達克指數跌0.3%，標普500指數跌0.4%，屬於成交清淡、方向不明的一日。市場並無明顯單一觸發因素，反映投資者觀望氣氛濃厚，交投及波動性均維持低迷。
